name: @builderforce/run-context
description: The ONE run-context contract shared by all three prompt-assembly surfaces (cloud `prepareCloudRun`, on-prem embedded runner, VS Code): the block taxonomy a run can receive, the renderer that turns blocks into a prompt, and the ContextReconciler that routes blocks through Evermind Write-Through Cognition so a surface receives the DELTA against what the run already knows. Dependency-free and I/O-free by contract — the api owns the data and serves the assembled envelope; this package owns its SHAPE and its reconciliation.
